correction.text: Tripoli and Tripolitania, which broke away from the Zirids after 1001

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. The page has no area; the infobox capital is Tripoli and the text names Tripolitania, with attacks 'around Gabès and Tripoli' (no year). The 120 km circle around Tripoli is the researcher's reading; Cliopatria's whole Tripolitania region (235,000 km2) would overstate it. The Zirids 'were able to retake Tripoli for a time' after 1009 and ceded it in 1022; the ledger carries the contest, the keyframe does not.

correction.text: Tripolitania and the Hammadid lands al-Muntasir took 'sometime around 1075': the M'zab and Righ, M'sila and Waghlana near Biskra

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, one year. 'Sometime around 1075, al-Muntasir took Hammadid territory: Ashir, al-Masila, the M'zab and Righ regions, and a base at Waghlana near Biskra'; Ashir is not placed. The page's ruler list gives al-Muntasir 1038-1049, which this sentence contradicts.

correction.text: Tripoli and Tripolitania, after the Hammadid governor of Biskra had al-Muntasir killed (no year)

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. Bridging: 'The Hammadid governor of Biskra later had him killed' (no year), and the page names no later gain or loss until the famine of 1146.

ledger.note: 1001: Tripolitania breaks from the Zirids. 'After 1001, Tripolitania broke away from Zirid control under the leadership of Fulful ibn Sa'id ibn Khazrun'; the infobox gives 'Established: 1001' and 'The Banu Khazrun were a family of the Maghrawa that ruled Tripoli from 1001 to 1146'; the rulers' list opens with Fulful in 1000/1001-1009/1010.

1009: the Zirids retake Tripoli. 'After his death in 1009, the Zirids were able to retake Tripoli for a time'; the page's ruler list nevertheless has Warru ibn Sa'id 1009/1010-1014/1015 and Khalifa ibn Warru from c. 1015.

1022: the Zirids cede Tripoli. 'The Zirids finally ceded Tripoli to the Banu Khazrun in 1022'; in 1026-7 Khalifa 'obtained from the Fatimid caliph in Cairo, al-Zahir, a formal confirmation' of his position as governor of Tripoli.

region.text: the M'zab and Righ, M'sila and Biskra country, from the Hammadids

ledger.note: c. 1075: al-Muntasir takes Hammadid lands. 'Sometime around 1075, al-Muntasir led the Banu Adi' against the Hammadid kingdom and took 'Ashir, al-Masila, the M'zab and Righ regions, and a base at Waghlana near Biskra'.

region.text: the M'zab and Righ, M'sila and Biskra country

ledger.note: 1076 (bridge): the Hammadids recover the lands. 'The Hammadid governor of Biskra later had him killed' (no year); the page says nothing of the lands afterwards.

1146: Tripoli falls to Roger II. 'By 1146, a famine drove the city's inhabitants to expel the Banu Khazrun'; 'This afforded Roger the opportunity to finally capture the city in 1146 or 1147.' 'In 1143, Roger II of Sicily tried and failed to take Tripoli from Muhammad ibn Khazrun.'
1146: the dynasty's rule ends. The infobox gives 'Disestablished: 1146'; 'The dynasty's rule came to an end at this time.'

wars.name: Khazrunid war against the Zirids
wars.outcome: 'Between 1038 and 1049, he waged a long war against the Zirids'; Khalifa launched attacks 'in the regions around Gabès and Tripoli' (no year); 'During the invasions of the Banu Hilal in 1051-1052, he accepted the authority of al-Mu'izz ibn Badis'.

wars.name: Al-Muntasir's raid on the Hammadids

zones.text: the M'zab, Righ, M'sila and Biskra country

wars.outcome: Around 1075 al-Muntasir led the Banu Adi against the Hammadid kingdom and took Ashir, al-Masila, the M'zab and Righ regions and a base at Waghlana near Biskra; the Hammadid governor of Biskra later had him killed.

wars.name: Roger II's attempts on Tripoli
wars.outcome: Roger II 'initiated an expedition in 1143 with the objective of capturing Tripoli', which 'was unsuccessful because the neighboring Banu Khazrun tribes staunchly defended the city' (infobox: Khazrunid victory, commander Muhammad ibn Khazrun); a famine drove the inhabitants to expel the Banu Khazrun by 1146 and Roger took the city 'in 1146 or 1147 at last'.

certainty.note: The page names Tripoli, Tripolitania and a few Hammadid towns, with no frontier; the 120 km circle and the Hammadid provinces are the researcher's.

notes: Cliopatria has no Khazrunid row (Tripolitania is inside its Hafsid row from 1236 and nothing before). Internal conflicts on the page: the Zirids retake Tripoli after 1009 'for a time' while the ruler list has Warru 1009/1010-1014/1015 and Khalifa from c. 1015; the same list ends al-Muntasir in 1049 while the Hammadid conquest is 'around 1075'; the text has Khazrun ibn Sa'id leave for Egypt around 1014-5 while the list puts Khazrun ibn Khalifa in 1037/1038. The Zirid dossier holds a vassal_end for Tripolitania in 1146 at confidence 1; the Hilalian invasion year of 1051-1052 on this page is the Zirid dossier's contest of 1052-1057. Ashir is not in the gazetteer and is not placed. The Fatimid confirmation of 1026-7 would be a vassal event for the Fatimid dossier; none is entered here. The Hammadid dossier has no event for the c. 1075 gain.
